description: Land Acquisition - Hombawa, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's intention to acquire multiple plots of land and servitudes for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, owner names, and extents. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisitions, property ownership details, and land-related administrative procedures.
